name: inflation
title: Annual inflation by GDP deflator and consumer prices
description: Annual inflation rates for countries worldwide, covering two measures: the GDP implicit deflator (NY.GDP.DEFL.KD.ZG) and consumer prices (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG). Both series are sourced from the World Bank and cover most countries from the 1960s onward.

resources.name: inflation-gdp
resources.description: Annual GDP deflator inflation rate (NY.GDP.DEFL.KD.ZG) for each country and year, as published by the World Bank. Each row represents one country-year observation. Rows are omitted when the World Bank reports no value for that country-year.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: Full country or territory name as used by the World Bank (e.g. 'United States', 'Africa Eastern and Southern').

fields.name: Country Code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, or a World Bank regional/aggregate code (e.g. 'USA', 'AFE').

fields.name: Inflation
fields.description: Annual percentage change in the GDP implicit deflator (NY.GDP.DEFL.KD.ZG). Measures economy-wide price changes relative to a base year.

resources.name: inflation-consumer
resources.description: Annual consumer price inflation rate (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG) for each country and year, as published by the World Bank. Each row represents one country-year observation. Rows are omitted when the World Bank reports no value for that country-year.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: Full country or territory name as used by the World Bank (e.g. 'United States', 'Africa Eastern and Southern').

fields.name: Country Code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, or a World Bank regional/aggregate code (e.g. 'USA', 'AFE').

fields.name: Inflation
fields.description: Annual percentage change in consumer prices (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG), as measured by the consumer price index (CPI).
